scope: API v2 field semantics, request accounting and published tariff status only

parameterDefinitions.symbols: Required comma-separated provider tickers; each symbol consumes a request unit.
parameterDefinitions.exchange: Optional MIC filter, independently validate each returned listing.
parameterDefinitions.sort: ASC or DESC, verify sorted unique dates locally.

fieldSemantics.adjustedFields: Official EOD description states split/dividend adjusted under CRSP methodology. This does not verify raw/adjusted OHLC or volume basis of a particular response or event.
fieldSemantics.splitFactor: Official SplitItem description: Split ratio applied on the date. Direction/effective-date and historical field basis require listing-specific validation.
fieldSemantics.priceCurrency: EOD schema declares a string, no row-level proof of correct currency or quote unit. Independently verified metadata may fill missing values with explicit provenance.
fieldSemantics.volume: Numeric field; schema does not certify unit or adjustment basis. Zero alone does not reject a price.
fieldSemantics.timestamp: ISO 8601 source timestamp, distinct from retrieval time. Latest is latest available trading day, not a realtime guarantee.
fieldSemantics.gbpGbx: Official docs distinguish XLON GBP and stocks quoted in GBX; do not scale without verified quote-unit metadata.

requestAccounting.definition: FAQ states five tickers in one API call consume five requests; API errors are not counted towards monthly quota.
requestAccounting.implementation: Conservatively reserve each symbol on every page and attempt, including errors/retries.

publishedPricing.implication: Published plan is not proof of current subscribed entitlement or remaining account credits. Unknown remaining monthly balance blocks mass requests. No subscription or purchase change performed.
